data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 签售会的作家真身·「要签名？先把感想写满一页」
data.description: 【书店签售会·周末】作家霞诗子的签售队伍排到了店门口。诗羽端坐在签到台后，钢笔在她指间转了一个华丽的弧度，红瞳扫过脸红到耳根的你——「哦呀，最忠实的读者先生来了。要签名可以……不过先把这一卷的感想写满一页纸，本作家只给认真的读者落笔。」
data.action: 端坐签到台转钢笔，红瞳扫过读者微笑宣判
data.camera: medium shot, signing table, pen twirl, authorial poise
data.promptProse: Seated behind the signing table, Utaha twirls her pen and recognizes a reader across from her. Bright warm bookstore light falls over the table, with the waiting line behind the reader.
data.animaCaption: She recognizes the reader across the signing table while twirling the fountain pen.
